blurb: The Davenport is a full-service event and reception hall, located in historic downtown Greer, SC - minutes from Greenville and Spartanburg. From weddings and receptions, to corporate seminars and meetings, we can make your event truly yours..... your favorite DJ, Caterer, Florist, it's your choice. Your event, your way, in a truly historic venue.
